intro.text: An area somewhere in the Roughs.

description.text: Several koloss tribes live here, making it very dangerous to enter, and red dust coats everything. There is a cave, and a small river in a canyon that swells after heavy rain and runs into the Rancid. The Elendel Daily claims precious, unknown metals can be found here.

items.text: Jak ventured in, ran into the koloss and found the Survivor's Treasure: a big aluminum chest full of spikes, lying in a pool of water.
